title.en: An Act to Amend Sections One and Two of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred Twenty-Four, Standardizing the Salaries of Municipal Judges in Accordance with the Classification of Chartered Cities and for Other Purposes

text.en:
Section two of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty-four is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. The municipal judges shall be entitled to thirty days vacation leave with pay for each year of service.
"Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the designation of the positions of municipal judge in chartered cities in the Philippines is hereby changed to that of city judge."
All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive signature on June 18, 1961.
